item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gives Its Best Boy the Happy Ending He Deserved Decades Ago
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2 makes a small, but welcome change to the fate of Richard the dog
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a mostly faithful remake, true, but there's a generous handful of tweaks and expansions that fill out this version of Hyrule beautifully. Most of those changes are grim. This game is sad — if speaking to the Kokiri after clearing The Great Deku Tree dungeon didn't clue you in on that, just chat to people with the Mask of Truth on — and it wants you to be sad too. One of these changes flies in the face of misery and is defiantly happy, though, and it involves the game's bestest boy: Richard.

item.title: The Best New Video Games of 2026 (So Far)
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Before GOTY season approaches, take a look back at some of the best games of 2026, from Cairn to Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave.
item.content:encoded: It's hard to believe, but 2026 is winding down. Well, maybe that's easy to believe if you remember that Code Vein 2 and Highguard kicked off the year in January, and both now feel like ancient history. We're getting closer to putting together our year-end game of the year come December, but there's still a long road until then. We're still catching up on a busy year of games, from big-budget hits to indie hidden gems. Oh, and there's still this little game called Grand Theft Auto 6 to consider.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Coolest Dungeon Hides a Secret Tribute to a Beloved Classic
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Nintendo's latest Zelda remake contains a clear reference to a coming-of-age-classic of American literature
item.content:encoded: Nintendo's highly anticipated remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is finally here, and millions of players are reliving their childhood adventures or experiencing Link's journey for the very first time. Though the Nintendo 64 game has received a dramatic visual glow-up for the Switch 2, the remake meticulously preserves the spirit of the original — including an extended reference to a classic American novel that even Ocarina diehards may have missed the first time around.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Best Replacement Has 11,000+ ‘Very Positive’ Reviews on Steam
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Death's Door turns five years old this year, and it's still one of the best games like The Legend of Zelda around.
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake was released last week, nearly three decades after the original came to Nintendo 64. Plenty of newcomers are discovering the greatest game ever for the first time (raises hand) on Nintendo Switch 2. However, as it’s a Switch 2 exclusive, plenty of gamers might be left feeling like Squidward watching everyone else have fun and frolic in Hyrule.

item.title: Every Legend of Zelda Game, Ranked
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Polygon ranks all the mainline games in Nintendo's Zelda series, including the 2026 Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time
item.content:encoded: Created by the great Shigeru Miyamoto in the 1980s as an expression of his childhood love of exploring without a map, Zelda has always held a revered position in gaming culture, although it never quite enjoyed popular success to match — not, that is, until its unlikely rebirth in 2017, thanks to the runaway success of the Nintendo Switch and the revolutionary design of Breath of the Wild.

item.title: Even More Free DLC for Hollow Knight: Silksong Might Be on the Way
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: The physical edition of Hollow Knight: Silksong indicate that free DLC might be on the way as well as additional "giant" expansions.
item.content:encoded: After approximately 100 years of waiting, Hollow Knight: Silksong was released last fall. Players were eager to jump into it as Silksong hit a peak of nearly 600,000 concurrent players on Steam alone. Critics adored it too as Silksong was nominated for several end-of-year awards and won a handful of them, such as Best Action/Adventure Game at The Game Awards. Around that time, Team Cherry announced it was working on a new Silksong expansion called Sea of Sorrow.

item.title: Warhammer’s Brutal Fantasy Football Game Just Suffered Another Setback
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Warhammer Blood Bowl has been delayed until 2027, but Blood Bowl 3 owners will receive a free upgrade and new teams.
item.content:encoded: Warhammer fans will have to wait a little longer to return to the fantasy football pitch, but the upcoming overhaul is bringing some welcome additions. Warhammer Blood Bowl has been delayed into early 2027, pushing the game's full release out of its previously planned 2026 launch window. Publisher Slitherine announced the delay during its Dominion Days showcase in Berlin, explaining that additional development time is needed to deliver a more polished experience.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Scarier Than Ever on Switch 2
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake makes the Nintendo 64 classic creepier than ever.
item.content:encoded: When I first encountered The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time growing up, it scared the crap out of me. The screeching Redeads, the skittering spiders, the disembodied hands — it was basically a horror movie to a young kid’s eyes. I’m older and harder to spook now, of course, which means that I knew the Nintendo 64 game’s fresh Switch 2 remake was bound to hit differently. Surely I’d laugh at everything that used to creep me out and realize that I was scared of a glorified cartoon!

item.title: Mike Flanagan’s 10-Episode Netflix Thriller Masterpiece Is Everything ‘Carrie’ Should Have Been
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: Mike Flanagan’s Carrie is missing one thing: fear. Luckily, his ghost-packed Netflix series has it in spades.
item.content:encoded: Mike Flanagan knows how to make horror. He also knows how to make serialized TV. His most recent show is a mix of most of the things we’ve come to love about him: his bond with Stephen King, his skills as an adapter, his great eye for casting, and his ability to deliver pathos. But one key thing is missing: fear.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time and WoW: Forever Are the Good Kind of Remakes
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Nintendo and Blizzard's new versions of The Legend of Zelda: OoT and World of Warcraft are different from other remakes
item.content:encoded: Patch Notes is a weekly newsletter bringing you the best of Polygon, sent on Fridays and published on the site on Sundays. You can subscribe here.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Thankfully Resists FromSoftware’s Influence
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time makes a lot of modernizations to the original game, but there's one thing it doesn't add: parrying.
item.content:encoded: This year in video games, I’ve swung a digital sword more times than I can count. Thrilling action games likeOnimusha: Way of the Sword and Phantom Blade Zero have gotten the feel of a sword fight down to a science, as steel clashes and sparks fly in spectacular fashion. But my favorite duels of the year aren’t in any of this year’s most razor-sharp action games; they’re all in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

item.title: Speedrunners Already Breaking The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Remake
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The addition of jumping to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has enabled a new speedrunning trick
item.content:encoded: Speedrunners have had their hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for a couple of days now, and some funky tricks have already been discovered. In particular, the remake's addition of a jumping mechanic has enabled new speedrunning tactics that just weren't possible in the Nintendo 64 original or its 3DS remake.

item.title: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina of Time For Switch 2 Could Bring Back A Classic Mode
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Master Quest might come to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Nintendo Switch 2 remake as DLC
item.content:encoded: Now that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Nintendo Switch 2 remake has been out for a couple of days, people are already looking for secrets tucked away within the game through datamining. One of the biggest discoveries from that is that Master Quest, which was missing from the remake at release, could be in the works.

item.title: Assassin's Creed Hexe Reportedly Delayed As New Assassin's Creed Games Leak
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: Some new insider reporting has shed new light on the future of Assassin's Creed
item.content:encoded: Some new reports regarding the Assassin's Creed series emerged last week, giving us a better idea of what to expect from Ubisoft's flagship series for the rest of the decade. While we learned about two Assassin's Creed titles for the first time, it has also been reported that the development of Assassin's Creed Hexe is taking longer than expected.

item.title: Magic’s Star Trek Set Doubles as a Must-Watch Guide to the Sci-Fi Franchise
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: From The Wrath of Khan to The Best of Both Worlds, discover the 14 Star Trek stories inspiring Magic: The Gathering's new Saga cards.
item.content:encoded: Prerelease events for Magic’s Star Trek begin this weekend before a global launch on Nov. 13. The set celebrates six decades of the franchise with cards featuring familiar characters, starships, and memorable adventures. Among them are 14 saga enchantments inspired by — and named after — 13 television episodes and one movie.

item.title: Cairn 'Belongs' Next to Death Stranding in ‘History of Grand Adventure Games'
item.dc:creator: Matt Patches
item.description: Cairn is the latest game from The Game Bakers, and though it looks like a sports game, it really has the spirit of an action-adventure game.
item.content:encoded: Game Bakers co-founder and Cairn producer Audrey Leprince did not set out to “simulate climbing.” The vision was to build an action-adventure game about survival, obsession, sacrifice, and what drives someone to accomplish the impossible. With Cairn’s new DLC On the Trail: Deep Water out now, Leprince spoke to Polygon about scaling the project and working with director Emeric Thoa to produce a project more meaningful than a simple sports game.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Beats The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim in One Major Way
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Ocarina of Time and The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim are two of the industry's biggest games, but their publishers have deployed them very differently.
item.content:encoded: After years spent dreaming of a remake or remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, the highest-rated video game of all time according to Metacritic, fans finally saw their wish fulfilled in 2026. Nintendo announced a remake for Switch 2 earlier this year, and the title arrived in stores this week.

item.title: Matt Mercer's Best Critical Role Quote Is Still the Most Inspiring Line in D&D History
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: If you're looking to become a Dungeon Master, Matthew Mercer's advice is all you need.
item.content:encoded: Matthew Mercer is one of the world's most popular Dungeon Masters. Alongside other incredible DMs like Deborah Ann Woll, Brennan Lee Mulligan, and Aabria Iyengar, Mercer has undeniably shaped how players worldwide approach tabletop role-playing games. As Critical Role, the multimedia entertainment company Mercer co-founded, has grown and evolved over the years, one thing has remained constant: Mercer’s willingness to help other tabletop players. He is especially eager to support aspiring Dungeon Masters who hope to develop their skills and become as accomplished as he is, even appearing on the official Dungeons & DragonsYouTube page to provide assistance.

item.title: Bethesda's Most Reviled Game Becomes a 10/10 If You Ignore the Story
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: If you bounced from one of Bethesda's biggest releases because the plot didn't spark interest, you missed out.
item.content:encoded: Recently, Bethesda dominated conversations simply by announcing that the long-awaited Elder Scrolls 6 has an official subtitle: Sentinel. We didn’t learn much more than that, but it was enough to keep us talking because that’s the sort of hold Bethesda has on us. Sometimes. There have been other instances, however, when the hold loosened.

item.title: 10 Perfectly Designed Final Fantasy Magic Cards That Are 10/10, No Notes
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: Discover 10 perfectly designed Final Fantasy Magic: The Gathering cards that nail the crossover's flavor and mechanics.
item.content:encoded: Packed with hilarious nods, like Suplex, and incredible powerhouses, like Diamond Weapon, it comes as no surprise that Final Fantasy is among the best Universe Beyond sets in the game. But the most perfect designs among them capture a fundamental element of their source material, whether that's Bahamut's devastating Mega Flare, Phoenix Down's clutch resurrection, or the sheer spectacle of summoning Primal Odin.

item.title: 9 Near-Perfect Dragon Age Replacements For Fans of Fantasy RPGs
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.description: If you're looking for the best games like Dragon Age, these Dragon Age replacement fantasy RPGs have you covered.
item.content:encoded: BioWare’s Dragon Age is a fantasy RPG series about warring factions, world-ending threats, and, yes, the occasional dragon – but that’s the first-glance take. Get into one Dragon Age game (start with Origins!) and you’ll see that the true heart of this series is the people you drag into hell with you.

item.title: 8 Near-Perfect BioWare Games That Aged Like Fine Wine
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.description: From Baldur's Gate to a surprisingly good Sonic RPG, these 8 BioWare games still hold up decades later
item.content:encoded: A pack of wolves can end a Baldur’s Gate 1playthrough a mere five minutes after the tutorial ends. A squadmate you didn’t bother checking in on in Mass Effect 2 can die permanently during a mission you don’t get to redo. And a Sonic RPG on the Nintendo DS can end its story with the good guys saving the universe…then coming home to find someone named Eggman conquered Earth while they were gone. Most people know BioWare as the Mass Effect studio, which is incredible on its own — but that undersells the vast range that built the studio’s reputation in the first place.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Meets Papers, Please in Steam’s Latest Surprise Viral Hit
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: Probably Stolen is the latest indie game to explode in popularity on Steam, pulling in over 150,000 concurrent players, and it's showing no signs of s
item.content:encoded: Every now and then, a game with little to no fanfare pre-launch gets blessed by the algorithm and surges in popularity. Probably Stolen is the latest recipient of this; after being released on Oct. 28, it's continued to climb in popularity, peaking at 174,382 concurrent players on Nov. 4, according to SteamDB.

item.title: Commander Shepard’s Actor Accidentally Immortalized One Mass Effect Race as Steve Buscemi
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Polygon spoke to Mass Effect's Mark Meer about how he joined the series and how he and fellow Shepard Jennifer Hale defined the character.
item.content:encoded: Mark Meer never planned on saving the universe, but the universe had other plans.

item.title: I Wouldn’t Dream of Playing the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Right Now
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Legenda of Zelda: OoT is sacred, so I'll be waiting to playing the Switch 2 remake
item.content:encoded: Switchboard is Polygon's weekly newsletter for all things Nintendo, sent on Thursdays and published on the site on Saturdays. You can subscribe here.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Physical Copies Are Officially in the Wild
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: Physical editions of GTA 6 have started to arrive at retailers, offering a first look at the box and its contents.
item.content:encoded: With preloads for Grand Theft Auto 6 just around the corner, Rockstar Games has sent the code-in-box editions to retailers, so stores can deliver them to customers on time. Shipments have started to arrive, giving us a first look at the physical edition of Grand Theft Auto 6.

item.title: Commander Shepard’s Actors Are ‘Wildly Hopeful’ for Mass Effect, Despite Everything
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Polygon spoke to Mass Effect's Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer about their optimism for Mass Effect after EA shut down BioWare and canceled Mass Effect 5.
item.content:encoded: Fans have tangled with a mix of emotions knowing that it’s unlikely they’ll ever get to play a new BioWare-developed Mass Effect again. But, if you ask the voices of Commander Shepard, they’re oddly optimistic about the future despite the circumstances. Polygon recently spoke to Mark Meer and Jennifer Hale, the voice actors for Shepard, about the strength of Mass Effect’s community, the closure of BioWare, and the studio’s legacy.

item.title: Wardogs Season 3 Will Add A Mode That Limits What Weapons Players Can Use
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: Wardogs' lengthier Season 3 will introduce Limited Mode, which should be friendlier to new players
item.content:encoded: Bulkhead and Team17 shared the first details on what players can expect from Wardogs Season 3 in a new video. One of the most notable additions is Limited Mode, a new way to play Wardogs that restricts what weapons and other upgrades players have access to.

item.title: Path of Exile 2 Sets The Stage For Massive Update Alongside December Launch
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: The campaign will wrap up and the Shadow class will be introduced next month
item.content:encoded: At ExileCon 2026, Grinding Gear Games gave us a deep dive into everything we can expect to be added to Path of Exile 2 by the time its 1.0 launch happens next month. That includes a new stealth-driven class, two more narrative acts for its campaign, and a new league called Conquerors of Wraeclast.

item.title: World of Warcraft Forever Officially Breaks Records For The 22-Year-Old MMO
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: World of Warcraft got a whole lot of people to come back and play the MMO together
item.content:encoded: Blizzard Entertainment launched World of Warcraft Forever on Nov. 4, and it already seems very happy with the results. The launch went much more smoothly than some previous Blizzard game releases, and it even broke some records, an impressive feat for something building on a nearly 22-year-old MMO.

item.title: Mass Effect’s Cruelest Moral Choice Remains Gaming's Most Haunting Mission 19 Years Later
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.description: Mass Effect’s Homecoming quest asks you to hand a widower his wife’s body or keep it for research. Neither ending feels clean, but one is better
item.content:encoded: So when, years later, an Alliance clerk told Shepard that a fallen marine named Nirali Bhatia “may save more lives in death than she did in life,” Shepard was faced with the decision — the opportunity — to make Nirali’s death count for something. Before the question ended, she was already agreeing. Hand a grieving husband his wife’s body? Or keep her for research that might save more lives down the line? Someone was going to pay for whichever answer I chose. (I knew Shepard would say yes. I also knew, thumbs hovering over the controller, that every part of me wished she wouldn’t.)

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Perfectly Captures the Sci-Fi Show’s Most Brutal Running Joke
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Lots of Redshirts are going to die
item.content:encoded: Generating creature tokens is a common way to make the most out of your resources in a game of Magic: The Gathering. They can be sacrificed for powerful effects, used to chump block, or amassed to overwhelm your opponent. Cards typically generate tokens of the same color, like white Warriors for Secure the Wastes, green Squirrels for Deranged Hermit, and black Zombies for Ghoulish Procession. Yet numerous cards in Magic: The Gathering Star Trek generate 1/1 red Officer tokens regardless of the base color, from the white Captain Benjamin Sisko to the green MACO Strike Team. The discrepancy is a nod to the sci-fi franchise’s darkest running joke.

item.title: The 8 Best Castlevania Games Of All Time, Ranked
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: The finest Castlevania games of all time come from multiple decades. Together, they built a franchise that is better than ever.
item.content:encoded: Castlevania is one of the most beloved franchises in video game history, despite a period of 13 years when we didn’t see a new installment until the launch of Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse earlier this year.

item.title: 10 Essential GBA Games Still Disappointingly Missing From Nintendo Switch Online
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: Loads of GBA classics are already available on Switch Online, but 10 more terrific games need to join the service.
item.content:encoded: When the original Game Boy came out, games like the ones people enjoyed on their NES were finally playable on the go, and players loved Nintendo for it. The green and black color palette was a bit of a bummer, but finally was rectified with the Game Boy Color. Even so, most of the games were still pretty basic. The next step was to make a handheld unit that could replicate the superior experience offered on the Super Nintendo, and the Game Boy Advance did precisely that.

item.title: 10 Devastating Game Cancellations That Are Still Disappointing Years Later
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: Canceled games are nothing new, but 10 exciting games were taken out of action before they could deliver on their promise.
item.content:encoded: Sometimes, it’s fun to think about the great games that might have been — until they were canceled without ever getting the chance to make their mark. Most of the time, we just shrug our shoulders and move on, because that’s life. But sometimes, we mourn the wasted potential.

item.title: GTA 6's Biggest Competition Officially Arrives on PC in 2027
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Ananta, the "anime GTA" game from NetEase, has an early 2027 release date, steering clear of Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to dominate 2026 with its long-awaited release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, another game — one heavily inspired by GTA, Marvel's Spider-Man, and Genshin Impact — will give Rockstar Games a run for its money: Ananta.

item.title: Critical Role Officially Returns to Its Roots for New Campaign with Hololive
item.dc:creator: Francesco Cacciatore
item.description: The details of Shattered Legends, Critical Role's new Exandria campaign featuring Hololive VTubers, have been revealed.
item.content:encoded: Announced in October, Shattered Legends is an upcoming miniseries featuring Critical Role and members of Hololive Production. Critical Role founders Matt Mercer and Marisha Ray will team up with Hololive’s Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, and Gigi Murin for a new adventure set in the world of Exandria, where the Critical Role story began with Campaign 1: Vox Machina.

item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Officially Fixes King Ghidorah Canon in 1 Brilliant Way
item.dc:creator: Jake Kleinman
item.description: The team behind Godzilla Minus Zero on the sights and sounds of King Ghidorah, and that awesome New York City scene
item.content:encoded: In an interview with Polygon, the film's producer, Kazuaki Kishida, wouldn't say exactly how big the budget for Godzilla Minus Zero was (though it's been confirmed to be a significantly "more" than Minus One's $15 million), but he did reveal one way that extra money changed how Yamazaki and his team approached making the sequel.

item.title: EA Officially Brings Back 25 PC Classics With Huge Sale
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.category: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger
Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom
item.description: EA just released 25 of its classic games on Steam, which includes seven new remasters.
item.content:encoded: Electronic Arts is not in players’ good graces right now. On Oct. 21, the publisher announced that it was closing BioWare, the beloved studio behind games like Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. The news came just a few months after EA was purchased by the Saudi Arabian government’s Public Investment Fund, Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners, and private equity firm Silver Lake. Despite these dismal circumstances, including the fact that EA is now owned by a government responsible for numerous human rights abuses, a small group of EA developers just finished an unexpected feel-good preservation project.

item.title: New Ratchet & Clank Game Officially Cancelled by Sony
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: The multiplayer shooter Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble is getting delisted this month and fully shut down next May.
item.content:encoded: Sony's next Ratchet & Clank game has been scrapped before receiving a full release. On Friday, Sony Interactive Entertainment and developer Oh BiBi announced Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble will be pulled from storefronts this month, and fully shut down next May.

item.title: 6 Upcoming Steam Games That Look Too Good to Ignore
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: A recent Nintendo showcase revealed tons of hidden gems, including half a dozen promising Steam indie games releasing soon.
item.content:encoded: As 2026 winds down, we’re now getting to the stretch of the year where developers are showcasing what games are coming next year. We recently got a glimpse of that in a Nintendo Indie World Showcase, which showed off several games coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. If you’re a PC player who skipped over the show, you’ll be delighted to know that just about every game shown during it is also coming to Steam.

item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero’s Final Trailer Reveals Legendary Monster Villain
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' just got its last trailer, which shows off the film’s monster villain.
item.content:encoded: Godzilla Minus Zero is finally here. The latest installment in this larger-than-life monster series is getting a wide release in the U.S. starting today. Toho marked the occasion by sharing the film’s final trailer, which gives us a look at one of Godzilla’s greatest foes, King Ghidorah.

item.title: Nintendo Hints the Switch 2 Will Keep Getting Classic Remakes
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Nintendo's Nate Bihldorff told Polygon how remakes fit into Nintendo's current Switch 2 game strategy.
item.content:encoded: This time last year, Nintendo’s 2026 plans were a bit of a mystery. We knew that games like Pokémon Pokopia and Mario Tennis Fever would round out the Switch 2’s first year, but we still had few clues about what would be 2026’s big game for the platform. Now, we know that Nintendo was hiding a big secret during that time. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Timewould be the Switch 2’s tentpole 2026 game, giving players (and Nintendo’ holiday sales) a blockbuster remake. Nate Bihldorff, Nintendo’s SVP of product development and publishing, knew that would be a very big deal.

item.title: Magic’s Most Broken New Mechanic Perfectly Captures the Essence of Star Trek
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: Magic’s Star Trek set turns the Federation’s commitment to diversity into a compelling mechanic that rewards you for building a varied crew.
item.content:encoded: If there’s one thing I do know about Star Trek, however, it’s that its vision of the future is brimming with optimism and curiosity. In tandem with that is an emphasis on the importance of diversity. I remember my dad watching Star Trek: The Next Generation when I was very young, and the “Wookiee guy” kind of scared me. These days, Worf (who is actually a Klingon) would probably be my favorite character. So it makes sense that what finally won me over about Magic's Trek connects directly to the franchise's idealistic core message.

item.title: PlayStation Store Black Friday 2026 Sale Is Live With Huge Deals
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: PS5 owners can get big discounts on PlayStation Store games like Marvel's Wolverine, NBA 2K27, Silent Hill Townfall, and more.
item.content:encoded: Sony's PlayStation Store Black Friday sale is now officially live, with thousands of games, game bundles, and add-on packs discounted for the holiday shopping season. The list includes PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 hits and recent releases such as Marvel's Wolverine, Control Resonant, and Silent Hill: Townfall, plus deep discounts of up to 85% off a long list of titles.
